visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up of a young woman with black hair in pigtails, wearing a grey low-cut top, scratching a lottery ticket at a wooden table. Her facial expression is one of intense focus and occasional smiles. The background shows a betting station interior with scooters parked outside in the distance. (2) The shot cuts to another young woman wearing a purple and black cat-ear beanie and a black low-cut top, also vigorously scratching a lottery ticket. Behind her, a poster with '2025' and '新年快樂' is visible on the wall. (3) A man with glasses and a black cap is shown scratching a ticket, smiling widely as someone's hand reaches in from the left to point at the ticket. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a retail shop. (4) The sequence returns to the first woman in the grey top, then to the woman in the beanie, showing them alternating between scratching and reacting with high energy, squinted eyes, and open mouths. (5) A close-up of a digital display screen is shown, resting on a counter next to a golden ingot ornament. The screen displays winning information with Chinese text. (6) The final scene shows a hand-to-hand exchange of a 1000 NTD bill over a glass counter. The first woman in the grey top is then seen dancing playfully and holding up the bill to the camera with a large, joyful smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with upbeat, fast-tempo electronic pop music. A female voice speaks in an excited Mandarin tone, accompanied by the distinct, high-frequency rhythmic scratching of paper. (2) A sharp 'slap' or impact SFX occurs as the scene cuts, followed by the man's laughter and more scratching sounds. The BGM remains consistent in volume. (3) The scratching intensifies in speed and volume, with multiple voices cheering and yelling in high arousal. A 'Cartoon/Comedy' bounce sound is audible. (4) As the machine screen is shown, a dramatic orchestral brass stinger SFX plays. The female voice exclaims in surprise with a rising intonation. (5) The final segment features loud cheering and a 'Wow!' vocal sound effect over the continuing BGM as the prize is collected. The overall audio atmosphere is joyful and high-energy.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a fun, high-energy group activity of scratching lottery tickets, culminating in the excitement of winning a cash prize.
